methodology.ranking: V19 v2 TOP10 alpha is the anchor. Within top-K, defensive rescue adds P(net-positive), inverse P(large-loss), and inverse volatility percentiles.
methodology.regimeGate: Market 5-session median return and breadth thresholds may keep the session in cash; cash return is 0 and still counts as a non-winning session.
methodology.policySelection: First development segment + last 20-session development validation; policy is selected before benchmark evaluation.
methodology.holdout: Latest 20-session benchmark reused after prior iterations and explicitly not fresh independent evidence.
